name: @pipeworx/mcp-manifold

tools.name: search_markets
tools.description: Search Manifold Markets prediction markets by topic or question text. Returns markets with current probability (for binary), trading volume, liquidity, bettor count, and resolution status. Manifold is a play-money venue with tens of thousands of user-created markets on any topic. Keyless.

term.description: Topic or question text to search for, e.g. "2026 election", "AGI", "Bitcoin 100k".

filter.description: Market state filter: all | open | closed | resolved. Default "open".

sort.description: Sort order: score | newest | liquidity | most-popular. Default "score".

contract_type.description: Market type filter: ALL | BINARY | MULTIPLE_CHOICE. Default "ALL".

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: Get full detail for a single Manifold market by its URL slug or id. Provide exactly one of slug/id. For multiple-choice markets, returns each answer with its probability (top 12). Includes plain-text description, creator, volume, liquidity, and resolution. Keyless.

slug.description: Market URL slug — the part after manifold.markets/{user}/, e.g. "who-will-win-the-2026-california-gu".

tools.name: top_markets
tools.description: Most-active open Manifold markets right now — a live attention/demand signal for what the prediction-market crowd is trading. Optionally narrow to a topic. Returns compact market records sorted by popularity. Keyless.

term.description: Optional topic to narrow to, e.g. "politics", "AI".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-manifold forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the manifold pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
